name: foodreach-selenium-tests
description: Selenium E2E tests (450 TCs) for FoodReach AI Platform — with Excel reporting

scripts.profile: mocha tests/profile.test.js --timeout 30000 --reporter json > results/profile-raw.json; node reporter/excelReporter.js profile
